concerns.text: Task T011 (outlier‑sensitivity analysis) is not linked to any functional requirement or success criterion in the spec. The spec does not mandate an outlier‑sensitivity check, so this task is an over‑reach. Either remove it or add a corresponding FR/SC to the specification.

Task T012 (a priori power analysis) is not referenced by any FR or SC in the spec. Power analysis is not a required deliverable, making this task an over‑reach. Consider deleting it or extending the spec with a new requirement if the power analysis is deemed essential.
